name: Wirebench Local API and SSH Workbench
free_limit: Apache-2.0 desktop application and CLI for local SOAP, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and MCP API testing, saved requests, CI runs and SSH workflows; no account, subscription, vendor usage quota or expiry for the desktop/CLI.
watch_out: This entry covers the local desktop/CLI only, not Wirebench Server. The separate self-hosted Server uses Elastic License 2.0 and its Community edition is limited to five seats; paid Team/Enterprise licenses apply. Users supply their own computer, target APIs and any infrastructure; external API usage may incur charges.
